## Appearance

Rogerson is a small beauty characterized by her long brown curls. She also has hazel eyes.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Rogerson is described as being particularly mean and horrid, despite her pretty appearance. Her bad temper has been directed toward [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) over an unknown grievance.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)_

## History

Miss Rogerson was a middle-aged Sunday-school teacher who had taught her class for twenty years. Her father recently married a second wife and brought her home from her grandmother's residence in Grafton. On her first day attending the Sunday school alone, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorated her plain dress with wild flowers and later recounted her experiences with Miss Rogerson and the other children to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P3](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XI.
